import { BattleFormatGui } from '@src/utils/battleMemoryMessage';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 比试
 * 指令：比试 [玩家UID/@目标]
 *
 * 消耗：10 元力/次
 * 每日上限：10 次
 * 奖励：胜利获得 14 修为 + 概率提升功法熟练度，失败获得 10 修为
 */

import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/spar/app';
import { sendSparLockedPage } from '@src/response/spar/access';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse, useMention } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  let UID = 0;
  let targetBid: string | undefined;

  const [mention] = useMention();

  // 提取数字
  const uidMatch = e.MessageText.match(/(\d+)/);

  if (uidMatch) {
    UID = Number(uidMatch[1]);
  } else {
    const user = await mention.findOne();

    if (user.data && user.count) {
      targetBid = user.data.UserId;
    }
  }

  try {
    const result = await App({
      bid,
      uid,
      targetUid: UID,
      targetBid,
      request: createBackendRequestContext(e)
    });

    if (result.code !== 'OK') {
      if (result.code === 'REALM_LOCKED') {
        sendSparLockedPage({ bid, isPrivate, message, realmName: result.data.realmName });

        return;
      }
      if (result.code === 'TARGET_NOT_FOUND' || result.code === 'NEED_TARGET') {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(result.data.message);
        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }
      if (result.code === 'SELF_TARGET' || result.code === 'DAILY_LIMIT') {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, Number(uid), '比试', result.data.message, createBackendRequestContext(e)));
        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }
      if (result.code === 'QI_NOT_ENOUGH') {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(result.data.message);
        void message.send(
          FormatGui({
            isPrivate,
            bid,
            title: '',
            content: md,
            footer: result.data.qiPillCount > 0 ? [{ label: '服用元力丹', command: '/服用 元力丹 3' }] : undefined
          })
        );

        return;
      }
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();
      const failMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, Number(uid), '比试', `比试失败：${result.data.message}`, createBackendRequestContext(e));

      md.addText(failMsg);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    UID = result.data.targetUid;
    const mdStart = Format.createMarkdown();

    mdStart.addText('比试开始...');
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: mdStart }));

    // 将旧式组件转为 md 内容（内联构建）
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();
    const sideACount = result.data.battleResult.finalState.sideA.length;
    const sideBCount = result.data.battleResult.finalState.sideB.length;
    const isTeamBattle = sideACount > 1 || sideBCount > 1;
    const showWave = result.data.battleResult.totalWaves > 1;

    md.addText('比试结果');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(
      Format.createMarkdown()
        .addText(`战斗类型：${sideACount}v${sideBCount}${isTeamBattle ? ' （队伍战）' : ''}`)
        .addNewline()
        .addText(`胜利方：${result.data.battleResult.winner === 'A' ? '你方' : result.data.battleResult.winner === 'B' ? '对方' : '平局'}`)
        .addNewline()
        .addText(`总回合数：${result.data.battleResult.totalRounds}`)
    );
    if (showWave) {
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`总波次：${result.data.battleResult.totalWaves}`));
    }
    md.addBlockquote(
      Format.createMarkdown().addText(`消耗元力：${result.data.hpCost}`).addNewline().addText(`今日次数：${result.data.newCount}/${result.data.dailyMax}`)
    );

    const isWin = result.data.battleResult.winner === 'A';

    if (isWin) {
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`修为获得：+${result.data.expGain}${result.data.expBonusText}`));
    } else {
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`修为获得：+${result.data.expGain}${result.data.expBonusText}`));
    }

    // 添加查看战斗过程按钮
    md.addNewline();
    // 比试后获取熟练点
    if (result.data.proficiencyResult?.gained) {
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(`📖 比试参悟，获得 ${result.data.proficiencyResult.points} 点熟练点`);

      md.addText(' ');
      md.addButton('[功法]', { data: '/我的功法' });

      md.addNewline();
    }

    void message.send(
      await BattleFormatGui(
        {
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '',
          content: md,
          footer: [
            { label: '文字记录', command: `/查看战斗过程 ${result.data.logId}` },
            { label: '继续比试', command: `/比试 ${UID}` },
          ]
        },
        [{ id: result.data.logId }]
      )
    );
  } catch (error) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();
    const failMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(
      bid,
      Number(uid),
      '比试',
      `比试失败：${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}`,
      createBackendRequestContext(e)
    );

    md.addText(failMsg);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});
